headline: Italy has wine for 5.6 billion bottles and puts the brakes on production
summary: Italian wine inventories exceed 5.6 billion bottles, and producers are reducing yields for Barbera d'Asti. A good harvest alone is not enough to rebalance supply.
why: Italy is one of the world's largest wine producers, and surplus stocks weigh on prices and producer revenues across the sector.
